realWorldScenario.headline: Enterprise Corporate Payroll & Department Management Engine
realWorldScenario.story: A multinational corporation operates diverse worker contracts: full-time salaried executives, contract hourly developers with overtime, and sales agents on commission. The enterprise payroll department requires an auditable engine to calculate earnings, verify department budgets, deduct taxes, and issue official payslips.
realWorldScenario.context: Every major ERP platform (SAP, Workday, Oracle HCM) relies on the exact polymorphic payroll architecture modeled in this capstone.

functional: Define a Payable interface with double calculateEarnings() and String getPaymentDescription().
Create an abstract class Employee implementing Payable with fields: id, name, departmentName, and socialSecurityNumber (masked).
Create SalariedEmployee: extends Employee, adds weeklySalary, calculates monthly earnings.
Create HourlyEmployee: extends Employee, adds hourlyRate and hoursWorked, computes 1.5x overtime for hours exceeding 40.
Create CommissionEmployee: extends Employee, adds grossSales and commissionRate (e.g. 10%).
Create a Department class: aggregates employees, enforces a maximum monthly budget, provides hireEmployee() and getDepartmentPayroll().
Create a PayrollEngine: processes all departments, validates budgets, deducts standard taxes (20%), and generates printable PaySlip vouchers.
Provide an interactive CLI driver with a menu for hiring employees, viewing departments, running payroll batches, and printing payslips.
technicalConstraints: Social security numbers or sensitive IDs must be masked in string outputs (e.g. 'XXX-XX-4819').
HourlyEmployee must calculate overtime at 1.5x for hours above 40 (standard labor law).
Department payroll must reject runs if total earnings exceed the allocated department budget.
Zero code duplication: common employee fields and methods must live in the abstract Employee superclass.
Classes must be organized cleanly into logical domain entities.
userDecisions: Choose department names and initial budget ceilings.
Decide whether to support custom tax rates per employee type.

inputsRequired: Employee credentials: ID, name, SSN, salary/rate/hours/sales
conditionalLogic: Hourly overtime: if (hoursWorked > 40) earnings = (40 * rate) + ((hoursWorked - 40) * rate * 1.5)
Department budget check: if (totalSalaries > budget) throw BudgetExceededException or print warning
Commission check: if (commissionRate <= 0.0 || commissionRate > 0.50) throw validation error
loopStructures: Polymorphic iteration over Department.getEmployees() in PayrollEngine
Interactive console menu loop (while running) in CapstoneAppMain
recommendedMethods: public abstract class Employee implements Payable

buildRoadmap.title: Payable Interface & Abstract Employee
buildRoadmap.objective: Build Payable interface and abstract Employee base class with masked SSN formatting.
tasks: Declare Payable interface with calculateEarnings() and getPaymentDescription().
Declare abstract class Employee implementing Payable with id, name, department, ssn.
Implement masked SSN utility method (e.g. '***-**-1234').
Add constructor with validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Employee compiles with abstract contract; SSN is safely masked in output.

buildRoadmap.title: Role Specializations (Salaried, Hourly, Commission)
buildRoadmap.objective: Implement the three concrete employee subclasses with respective compensation math.
tasks: Implement SalariedEmployee calculating earnings = weeklySalary * 4.
Implement HourlyEmployee with overtime multiplier (1.5x for hours > 40).
Implement CommissionEmployee with sales * commissionRate calculation.
Add constructor chaining via super(...) in each subclass.
acceptanceCriteria: All 3 classes accurately compute earnings under normal and boundary conditions (e.g. 45 hours worked).

buildRoadmap.title: Department Aggregate & Budget Enforcement
buildRoadmap.objective: Build Department class composing employees and enforcing budget ceiling.
tasks: Implement Department with name, budget, and List<Employee>.
Implement addEmployee(Employee e).
Implement calculateDepartmentPayroll() summing all employee earnings.
Implement isOverBudget() checking payroll against budget.
acceptanceCriteria: Department correctly manages its employee roster and flags budget overruns.

buildRoadmap.title: PayrollEngine & PaySlip Generation
buildRoadmap.objective: Build PayrollEngine generating official payslips with tax deductions.
tasks: Create PaySlip value object holding employee, gross, tax (20%), and net pay.
Implement processPayroll(Department dept) generating payslips for all staff.
Format official ASCII payslip voucher output.
acceptanceCriteria: Engine calculates net pay and prints structured company vouchers.

buildRoadmap.title: Interactive Capstone CLI Application
buildRoadmap.objective: Build the final CapstoneAppMain driver with interactive menu options.
tasks: Create interactive menu loop with options: 1. View Departments, 2. Hire Employee, 3. Run Payroll, 4. Print PaySlip, 5. Exit.
Seed sample departments (Engineering, Sales, Operations) and staff.
Test complete workflow from hiring to payroll payout.
acceptanceCriteria: Full capstone application runs interactively with zero errors.

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: How does the Payable interface enable future expansion for non-employee costs (e.g. ContractorInvoice)?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: By defining a Payable interface, PayrollEngine doesn't need to know if an entity is an Employee. It can process ContractorInvoice, VendorBill, or EquipmentLease seamlessly, as long as they implement calculateEarnings() and getPaymentDescription().

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: Why is HourlyEmployee overtime calculated at (40 * rate) + (overtimeHours * rate * 1.5)?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: Standard labor law mandates overtime at time-and-a-half (1.5x) for hours worked beyond 40 per week. If a worker works 48 hours at $20/hr, they earn $800 regular pay + $240 overtime pay = $1,040.

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: How does this Capstone demonstrate all 5 core OOP principles?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: Encapsulation: private fields with validated getters. Abstraction: abstract Employee and Payable interface. Inheritance: Salaried/Hourly/Commission extending Employee. Polymorphism: PayrollEngine invoking calculateEarnings() across mixed types. Composition: Department Has-A collection of Employees.

hintSystem.level1Conceptual: Check if hoursWorked > 40. If yes, pay base for 40 hours plus 1.5x for the remainder.
hintSystem.level2Implementation: if (hours <= 40) return hours * rate; else return (40 * rate) + ((hours - 40) * rate * 1.5);

hintSystem.level1Conceptual: Show only the last 4 digits of the SSN.
hintSystem.level2Implementation: Use substring(ssn.length() - 4) with a fixed prefix 'XXX-XX-'.

normalCases: HourlyEmployee with $25/hr and 45 hours -> Base (40*$25=$1,000) + Overtime (5*$37.50=$187.50) = $1,187.50
PayrollEngine processes department: computes 20% tax and net pay for all employees
boundaryCases: HourlyEmployee with exactly 40 hours -> Exactly 0 overtime hours applied
Department operating at exactly 100% of budget -> Approved without warning
invalidInputCases: Department total salaries exceed allocated budget -> Flagged with BUDGET EXCEEDED alert
Passing negative hourly rate or negative sales amount -> Caught and rejected in constructors
edgeCases: Full interactive session creating a new department, hiring 3 diverse employees, and running an audited payroll run

debuggingGuide: Overtime calculation paying 1.5x for ALL hours: Make sure you only multiply the hours ABOVE 40 by 1.5, not the total hours!
Negative pay after tax: Verify tax rate is a fraction (0.20 for 20%), not 20.0 (which would deduct 2000%!).
Polymorphic array type mismatch: Use List<Employee> or List<Payable> in Department to store mixed employee subclasses.
NullPointerException in payslip print: Ensure all employee fields (name, id, ssn) are validated as non-null during construction.
projectPolish: Render official ASCII Payslip Vouchers with border lines, watermark headers, and clear deductions.
Display an ASCII executive dashboard summarizing company payroll by department.
Include an interactive terminal prompt allowing hiring and immediate payslip viewing.

# Capstone: Enterprise Employee Management & Payroll System (Java OOP)

## Overview
The comprehensive Capstone Portfolio Project synthesizing all Object-Oriented Programming pillars in Java. Models an enterprise multi-tier workforce, multi-contract compensation logic, department budget governance, automated payroll execution, and audited payslip generation.

## Architecture Blueprint (UML)
```
                                +---------------------------------+
                                |       <<interface>>             |
                                |            Payable              |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                | + calculateEarnings(): double   |
                                | + getPaymentDescription(): Str  |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                                 ^
                                                 |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                |       <<abstract class>>        |
                                |            Employee             |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                | # id: String                    |
                                | # name: String                  |
                                | # departmentName: String        |
                                | - ssn: String                   |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                | + getMaskedSsn(): String        |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                                 ^
                                                 |
          +--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
          |                                      |                                      |
+-----------------------+              +-----------------------+              +-----------------------+
|   SalariedEmployee    |              |    HourlyEmployee     |              |  CommissionEmployee   |
+-----------------------+              +-----------------------+              +-----------------------+
| - weeklySalary: double|              | - hourlyRate: double  |              | - grossSales: double  |
+-----------------------+              | - hoursWorked: double |              | - commissionRate: dbl |
| + calculateEarnings() |              +-----------------------+              +-----------------------+
+-----------------------+              | + calculateEarnings() |              | + calculateEarnings() |
                                       |   (1.5x Overtime)     |              +-----------------------+
                                       +-----------------------+

+---------------------------------+              +---------------------------------+
|           Department            |              |          PayrollEngine          |
+---------------------------------+              +---------------------------------+
| - name: String                  |              | + processPayroll(dept: Dept)    |
| - monthlyBudget: double         |              | + generatePaySlip(emp: Employee)|
| - employees: List<Employee>     |              +---------------------------------+
+---------------------------------+                              |
| + hireEmployee(emp: Employee)   |                              v
| + calculateTotalPayroll(): dbl  |              +---------------------------------+
| + isOverBudget(): boolean       |              |             PaySlip             |
+---------------------------------+              +---------------------------------+
                                                 | - grossPay: double              |
                                                 | - taxDeduction: double (20%)    |
                                                 | - netPay: double                |
                                                 +---------------------------------+
                                                 | + printVoucher(): void          |
                                                 +---------------------------------+
```

## Core Principles Synthesized
- **Abstraction**: `Payable` interface decoupled from concrete payroll implementations.
- **Encapsulation**: Private fields, masked sensitive credentials (SSN), budget invariants.
- **Inheritance**: `SalariedEmployee`, `HourlyEmployee`, and `CommissionEmployee` extending `Employee`.
- **Polymorphism**: `PayrollEngine` evaluates all worker types through the `Payable` interface at runtime.
- **Composition**: `Department` aggregates workers; `PayrollEngine` coordinates batch execution.

## How to Run
```bash
javac *.java
java CapstoneAppMain
```

## Sample Official PaySlip Voucher

Employee Name:     Elena Rostova
Department:        Engineering & Platform Infrastructure
SSN Reference:     XXX-XX-8812
Employment Type:   Hourly Professional (45.0 hrs @ $45.00/hr + 1.5x OT)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Gross Earnings:    $2,137.50
Tax Withheld (20%): $427.50
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

# Capstone: Enterprise Employee Management & Payroll System (Java OOP)

## Overview
The comprehensive Capstone Portfolio Project synthesizing all Object-Oriented Programming pillars in Java. Models an enterprise multi-tier workforce, multi-contract compensation logic, department budget governance, automated payroll execution, and audited payslip generation.

## Architecture Blueprint (UML)
```
                                +---------------------------------+
                                |       <<interface>>             |
                                |            Payable              |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                | + calculateEarnings(): double   |
                                | + getPaymentDescription(): Str  |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                                 ^
                                                 |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                |       <<abstract class>>        |
                                |            Employee             |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                | # id: String                    |
                                | # name: String                  |
                                | # departmentName: String        |
                                | - ssn: String                   |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                | + getMaskedSsn(): String        |
                                +---------------------------------+
                                                 ^
                                                 |
          +--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
          |                                      |                                      |
+-----------------------+              +-----------------------+              +-----------------------+
|   SalariedEmployee    |              |    HourlyEmployee     |              |  CommissionEmployee   |
+-----------------------+              +-----------------------+              +-----------------------+
| - weeklySalary: double|              | - hourlyRate: double  |              | - grossSales: double  |
+-----------------------+              | - hoursWorked: double |              | - commissionRate: dbl |
| + calculateEarnings() |              +-----------------------+              +-----------------------+
+-----------------------+              | + calculateEarnings() |              | + calculateEarnings() |
                                       |   (1.5x Overtime)     |              +-----------------------+
                                       +-----------------------+

+---------------------------------+              +---------------------------------+
|           Department            |              |          PayrollEngine          |
+---------------------------------+              +---------------------------------+
| - name: String                  |              | + processPayroll(dept: Dept)    |
| - monthlyBudget: double         |              | + generatePaySlip(emp: Employee)|
| - employees: List<Employee>     |              +---------------------------------+
+---------------------------------+                              |
| + hireEmployee(emp: Employee)   |                              v
| + calculateTotalPayroll(): dbl  |              +---------------------------------+
| + isOverBudget(): boolean       |              |             PaySlip             |
+---------------------------------+              +---------------------------------+
                                                 | - grossPay: double              |
                                                 | - taxDeduction: double (20%)    |
                                                 | - netPay: double                |
                                                 +---------------------------------+
                                                 | + printVoucher(): void          |
                                                 +---------------------------------+
```

## Core Principles Synthesized
- **Abstraction**: `Payable` interface decoupled from concrete payroll implementations.
- **Encapsulation**: Private fields, masked sensitive credentials (SSN), budget invariants.
- **Inheritance**: `SalariedEmployee`, `HourlyEmployee`, and `CommissionEmployee` extending `Employee`.
- **Polymorphism**: `PayrollEngine` evaluates all worker types through the `Payable` interface at runtime.
- **Composition**: `Department` aggregates workers; `PayrollEngine` coordinates batch execution.

## How to Run
```bash
javac *.java
java CapstoneAppMain
```

realWorldScenario.headline: Enterprise Corporate Payroll & Department Management Engine
realWorldScenario.story: A multinational corporation operates diverse worker contracts: full-time salaried executives, contract hourly developers with overtime, and sales agents on commission. The enterprise payroll department requires an auditable engine to calculate earnings, verify department budgets, deduct taxes, and issue official payslips.
realWorldScenario.context: Every major ERP platform (SAP, Workday, Oracle HCM) relies on the exact polymorphic payroll architecture modeled in this capstone.

functional: Define a Payable interface with double calculateEarnings() and String getPaymentDescription().
Create an abstract class Employee implementing Payable with fields: id, name, departmentName, and socialSecurityNumber (masked).
Create SalariedEmployee: extends Employee, adds weeklySalary, calculates monthly earnings.
Create HourlyEmployee: extends Employee, adds hourlyRate and hoursWorked, computes 1.5x overtime for hours exceeding 40.
Create CommissionEmployee: extends Employee, adds grossSales and commissionRate (e.g. 10%).
Create a Department class: aggregates employees, enforces a maximum monthly budget, provides hireEmployee() and getDepartmentPayroll().
Create a PayrollEngine: processes all departments, validates budgets, deducts standard taxes (20%), and generates printable PaySlip vouchers.
Provide an interactive CLI driver with a menu for hiring employees, viewing departments, running payroll batches, and printing payslips.
technicalConstraints: Social security numbers or sensitive IDs must be masked in string outputs (e.g. 'XXX-XX-4819').
HourlyEmployee must calculate overtime at 1.5x for hours above 40 (standard labor law).
Department payroll must reject runs if total earnings exceed the allocated department budget.
Zero code duplication: common employee fields and methods must live in the abstract Employee superclass.
Classes must be organized cleanly into logical domain entities.
userDecisions: Choose department names and initial budget ceilings.
Decide whether to support custom tax rates per employee type.

inputsRequired: Employee credentials: ID, name, SSN, salary/rate/hours/sales
conditionalLogic: Hourly overtime: if (hoursWorked > 40) earnings = (40 * rate) + ((hoursWorked - 40) * rate * 1.5)
Department budget check: if (totalSalaries > budget) throw BudgetExceededException or print warning
Commission check: if (commissionRate <= 0.0 || commissionRate > 0.50) throw validation error
loopStructures: Polymorphic iteration over Department.getEmployees() in PayrollEngine
Interactive console menu loop (while running) in CapstoneAppMain
recommendedMethods: public abstract class Employee implements Payable

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: How does the Payable interface enable future expansion for non-employee costs (e.g. ContractorInvoice)?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: By defining a Payable interface, PayrollEngine doesn't need to know if an entity is an Employee. It can process ContractorInvoice, VendorBill, or EquipmentLease seamlessly, as long as they implement calculateEarnings() and getPaymentDescription().

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: Why is HourlyEmployee overtime calculated at (40 * rate) + (overtimeHours * rate * 1.5)?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: Standard labor law mandates overtime at time-and-a-half (1.5x) for hours worked beyond 40 per week. If a worker works 48 hours at $20/hr, they earn $800 regular pay + $240 overtime pay = $1,040.

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: How does this Capstone demonstrate all 5 core OOP principles?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: Encapsulation: private fields with validated getters. Abstraction: abstract Employee and Payable interface. Inheritance: Salaried/Hourly/Commission extending Employee. Polymorphism: PayrollEngine invoking calculateEarnings() across mixed types. Composition: Department Has-A collection of Employees.

hintSystem.level1Conceptual: Check if hoursWorked > 40. If yes, pay base for 40 hours plus 1.5x for the remainder.
hintSystem.level2Implementation: if (hours <= 40) return hours * rate; else return (40 * rate) + ((hours - 40) * rate * 1.5);

hintSystem.level1Conceptual: Show only the last 4 digits of the SSN.
hintSystem.level2Implementation: Use substring(ssn.length() - 4) with a fixed prefix 'XXX-XX-'.

PayrollEngine processes department: computes 20% tax and net pay for all employees
boundaryCases: HourlyEmployee with exactly 40 hours -> Exactly 0 overtime hours applied

portfolioChecklist: Payable interface is declared with calculateEarnings() and getPaymentDescription()
Employee is an abstract class implementing Payable with masked SSN support
SalariedEmployee, HourlyEmployee, and CommissionEmployee implement calculateEarnings() correctly
HourlyEmployee implements 1.5x overtime for hours worked exceeding 40
Department composes List<Employee> and enforces monthly budget limits
PayrollEngine processes payroll batches polymorphically and computes 20% statutory deductions
PaySlip prints official, aligned company payment vouchers
CapstoneAppMain provides an interactive menu for managing staff and departments
README.md includes full UML architecture diagram and execution instructions
explainYourProject: How does this capstone project synthesize all 5 pillars of Object-Oriented Programming?
Why is Payable defined as an interface rather than putting calculateEarnings directly in Employee?
How does HourlyEmployee handle overtime pay mathematically and in code?
How does Department enforce budget limits when hiring or executing payroll?
How does PayrollEngine demonstrate runtime polymorphism during batch processing?
What security precautions are taken with sensitive employee data like SSNs?
